name: Trapper's kit
body:
Source Dungeoneer's Handbook pg. 7
Price 263 gp; Weight 90 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This kit is particularly useful for dungeon explorers who specialize in trapping or taming whatever vile quarry they find. A trapper’s kit contains an average lock, a bear trapAPG, a container of bone paste (see page 26), a Small cageAPG, a set of manacles, a bag of marblesAPG, 50 feet of silk rope, two tanglefoot bags, 50 feet of twineAPG, and a wireUE.
